# Purpose

This notebook creates the 2022 master sample key used to connect:

- field samples;
- genotypes and plots;
- Micro IDs;
- Fiber IDs;
- MiniSpin run numbers;
- draw-frame ratch settings;
- AFIS processing stages;
- MiniSpin processing records;
- and later yarn-quality measurements.

The final master key should contain one row per biological field sample.

# 1. Purpose

This notebook creates the 2022 master sample key connecting field samples,
genotypes, plots, Fiber IDs, MiniSpin run numbers, AFIS processing stages,
processing records, and subsequent yarn measurements.

The final master key should contain one row per biological field sample.

# 2. Locate input workbooks

```{r locate-input-files}
find_single_workbook <- function(pattern, description) {

  matches <- list.files(
    paths$data_raw,
    pattern = pattern,
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  if (length(matches) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No ", description, " workbook was found in:\n",
      paths$data_raw
    )
  }

  if (length(matches) > 1) {
    stop(
      "More than one ", description, " workbook was found:\n",
      paste(basename(matches), collapse = "\n")
    )
  }

  matches
}

yarn_file <- find_single_workbook(
  "^UGA MSL Yarn Results.*\\.xlsx$",
  "yarn"
)

afis_file <- find_single_workbook(
  "^UGA AFIS Results.*\\.xlsx$",
  "AFIS"
)

minispin_file <- find_single_workbook(
  "^2022 UGA Mini-Spin Raw Data.*\\.xlsx$",
  "MiniSpin"
)

input_file_check <- tibble::tibble(
  workbook = c("Yarn", "AFIS", "MiniSpin"),
  filename = basename(
    c(yarn_file, afis_file, minispin_file)
  ),
  exists = file.exists(
    c(yarn_file, afis_file, minispin_file)
  ),
  full_path = c(
    yarn_file,
    afis_file,
    minispin_file
  )
)

input_file_check
```

# 4. Column-location helper

```{r column-helper}
find_column <- function(
  data,
  candidates,
  required = TRUE,
  description = "required"
) {

  match <- candidates[
    candidates %in% names(data)
  ][1]

  if (
    length(match) == 0 ||
    is.na(match)
  ) {

    if (required) {
      stop(
        "\nCould not locate the ",
        description,
        " column.\n\nCandidate names:\n",
        paste(candidates, collapse = ", "),
        "\n\nAvailable names:\n",
        paste(names(data), collapse = ", ")
      )
    }

    return(NA_character_)
  }

  match
}
```

# 5. Improved genotype-name standardization

The original labels include suffixes such as `_01`. These suffixes are
removed before genotype names are matched.

```{r genotype-standardization}
standardize_genotype_2022 <- function(x) {

  cleaned <- x |>
    as.character() |>
    stringr::str_trim() |>

    # Remove trailing replicate/version suffixes such as _01
    stringr::str_remove(
      regex(
        "[_-]0*[0-9]+$",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    ) |>

    stringr::str_replace_all(
      "[[:space:]_-]+",
      ""
    ) |>

    stringr::str_to_upper()

  dplyr::recode(

    cleaned,

    "AC107NEG" = "AC107Neg",
    "AC107POS" = "AC107Pos",

    "AC164NEG" = "AC164Neg",
    "AC164POS" = "AC164Pos",

    "ACSJ4" = "ACSJ4",
    "ACALASJ4" = "ACSJ4",

    "DP213NEG" = "DP213Neg",
    "DP213POS" = "DP213Pos",

    "DP263NEG" = "DP263Neg",
    "DP263POS" = "DP263Pos",

    "DP50" = "DP50",
    "DELTAPINE50" = "DP50",

    "GA428NEG" = "GA428Neg",
    "GA428POS" = "GA428Pos",

    "GA437NEG" = "GA437Neg",
    "GA437POS" = "GA437Pos",

    "GA089" = "GA089",
    "GA2004089" = "GA089",

    "PM304NEG" = "PM304Neg",
    "PM304POS" = "PM304Pos",

    "PM321NEG" = "PM321Neg",
    "PM321POS" = "PM321Pos",

    "PMHS26" = "PMHS26",
    "PAYMASTERHS26" = "PMHS26",

    "SEALAND883" = "SL883",
    "SL883" = "SL883",

    # Labels observed in the 2022 cross-reference
    "GA2018001" = "GA201800",
    "GA2018081" = "GA201808",

    "GA201800" = "GA201800",
    "GA201808" = "GA201808",

    .default = NA_character_
  )
}
```

# 8. Clean cross-reference records

```{r clean-cross-reference}
cross_ref <- tibble::tibble(

  field_sample_id = clean_identifier(
    cross_ref_raw[[cross_sample_col]]
  ),

  genotype_original = as.character(
    cross_ref_raw[[cross_genotype_col]]
  ),

  genotype = standardize_genotype_2022(
    cross_ref_raw[[cross_genotype_col]]
  ),

  micro_id = if (!is.na(cross_micro_col)) {
    clean_identifier(
      cross_ref_raw[[cross_micro_col]]
    )
  } else {
    NA_character_
  },

  plot = if (!is.na(cross_plot_col)) {
    safe_numeric(
      cross_ref_raw[[cross_plot_col]]
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  },

  fiber_id = clean_identifier(
    cross_ref_raw[[cross_fiber_col]]
  ),

  minispin_run = clean_identifier(
    cross_ref_raw[[cross_run_col]]
  ),

  hvi_length_for_ratch = if (!is.na(cross_length_col)) {
    safe_numeric(
      cross_ref_raw[[cross_length_col]]
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  },

  ratch = if (!is.na(cross_ratch_col)) {
    safe_numeric(
      cross_ref_raw[[cross_ratch_col]]
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

) |>

  dplyr::left_join(
    genotype_key,
    by = "genotype"
  ) |>

  dplyr::mutate(

    # Provisional field-replication inference from plot prefix
    plot_prefix = stringr::str_sub(
      as.character(as.integer(plot)),
      1,
      2
    ),

    field_rep_inferred = dplyr::recode(
      plot_prefix,
      "11" = 1L,
      "12" = 2L,
      "13" = 3L,
      "14" = 4L,
      .default = NA_integer_
    )
  )

dplyr::glimpse(cross_ref)
```

The inferred replication should be checked against the original field map
before it is used as the final replication variable.

# 12. Clean AFIS stage identifiers

The AFIS Fiber ID contains a processing-stage suffix:

- no suffix = Bale;
- `A` = Opened;
- `B` = Carded;
- `C3` = Sliver.

```{r clean-afis-identifiers}
afis_ids <- tibble::tibble(

  afis_fiber_id_original = clean_identifier(
    afis_avg_raw[[afis_sample_col]]
  ),

  minispin_run = if (!is.na(afis_run_col)) {
    clean_identifier(
      afis_avg_raw[[afis_run_col]]
    )
  } else {
    NA_character_
  },

  processing_stage_original = if (!is.na(afis_stage_col)) {
    as.character(
      afis_avg_raw[[afis_stage_col]]
    )
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }

) |>

  dplyr::mutate(

    afis_suffix = dplyr::case_when(

      stringr::str_detect(
        afis_fiber_id_original,
        stringr::regex(
          "C3$",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) ~ "C3",

      stringr::str_detect(
        afis_fiber_id_original,
        stringr::regex(
          "A$",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) ~ "A",

      stringr::str_detect(
        afis_fiber_id_original,
        stringr::regex(
          "B$",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) ~ "B",

      TRUE ~ ""
    ),

    # Remove C3 before removing single-letter suffixes
    fiber_id = afis_fiber_id_original |>

      stringr::str_remove(
        stringr::regex(
          "C3$",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ) |>

      stringr::str_remove(
        stringr::regex(
          "[AB]$",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ),

    stage_from_suffix = dplyr::case_when(
      afis_suffix == "" ~ "Bale",
      afis_suffix == "A" ~ "Opened",
      afis_suffix == "B" ~ "Carded",
      afis_suffix == "C3" ~ "Sliver",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    stage_from_column = if (!is.na(afis_stage_col)) {

      standardize_stage(
        processing_stage_original
      )

    } else {

      NA_character_

    },

    processing_stage = dplyr::coalesce(
      stage_from_column,
      stage_from_suffix
    ),

    stage_agreement = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(stage_from_column) ~ NA,
      stage_from_column == stage_from_suffix ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

dplyr::glimpse(afis_ids)
```

# 15. Build one AFIS completeness row per sample

```{r build-afis-completeness}
afis_stage_summary <- afis_ids |>
  dplyr::count(
    fiber_id,
    minispin_run,
    processing_stage,
    name = "n_records"
  ) |>

  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = processing_stage,
    values_from = n_records,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_prefix = "afis_"
  )
```

```{r ensure-afis-stage-columns}
expected_afis_columns <- c(
  "afis_Bale",
  "afis_Opened",
  "afis_Carded",
  "afis_Sliver"
)

for (column_name in expected_afis_columns) {

  if (!column_name %in% names(afis_stage_summary)) {
    afis_stage_summary[[column_name]] <- 0L
  }
}
```

```{r calculate-afis-completeness}
afis_stage_summary <- afis_stage_summary |>
  dplyr::mutate(

    afis_stage_count =
      as.integer(afis_Bale > 0) +
      as.integer(afis_Opened > 0) +
      as.integer(afis_Carded > 0) +
      as.integer(afis_Sliver > 0),

    afis_all_four_stages =
      afis_Bale == 1 &
      afis_Opened == 1 &
      afis_Carded == 1 &
      afis_Sliver == 1,

    afis_duplicate_stage =
      afis_Bale > 1 |
      afis_Opened > 1 |
      afis_Carded > 1 |
      afis_Sliver > 1
  )

afis_stage_summary |>
  dplyr::count(
    afis_stage_count,
    afis_all_four_stages,
    afis_duplicate_stage
  )
```

The corrected AFIS completeness table should contain approximately 92 rows.

# 18. Clean processing identifiers

```{r clean-processing-identifiers}
if (
  is.na(processing_fiber_col) &&
  is.na(processing_run_col)
) {

  processing_ids <- tibble::tibble(
    fiber_id = character(),
    minispin_run = character(),
    processing_record_available = logical()
  )

  warning(
    "No processing Fiber ID or run column was identified."
  )

} else {

  processing_ids <- tibble::tibble(

    fiber_id = if (!is.na(processing_fiber_col)) {
      clean_identifier(
        processing_raw[[processing_fiber_col]]
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },

    minispin_run = if (!is.na(processing_run_col)) {
      clean_identifier(
        processing_raw[[processing_run_col]]
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },

    processing_record_available = TRUE

  ) |>

    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(fiber_id) |
      !is.na(minispin_run)
    ) |>

    dplyr::distinct()
}

dplyr::glimpse(processing_ids)
```

# 19. Determine processing join method

Use both identifiers when both are populated and unique. Otherwise, use
the identifier available in the processing workbook.

```{r choose-processing-join}
processing_has_fiber <- (
  nrow(processing_ids) > 0 &&
  any(!is.na(processing_ids$fiber_id))
)

processing_has_run <- (
  nrow(processing_ids) > 0 &&
  any(!is.na(processing_ids$minispin_run))
)

processing_duplicate_fiber <- processing_ids |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(fiber_id)) |>
  dplyr::count(fiber_id) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

processing_duplicate_run <- processing_ids |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(minispin_run)) |>
  dplyr::count(minispin_run) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

processing_duplicate_fiber
processing_duplicate_run
```

# 20. Build master sample key

```{r build-master-key}
sample_key_2022 <- cross_ref |>

  dplyr::left_join(
    afis_stage_summary,
    by = c(
      "fiber_id",
      "minispin_run"
    )
  )
```

```{r add-processing-records}
if (
  processing_has_fiber &&
  processing_has_run
) {

  sample_key_2022 <- sample_key_2022 |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      processing_ids,
      by = c(
        "fiber_id",
        "minispin_run"
      )
    )

  processing_join_method <-
    "fiber_id + minispin_run"

} else if (
  processing_has_run &&
  nrow(processing_duplicate_run) == 0
) {

  sample_key_2022 <- sample_key_2022 |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      processing_ids |>
        dplyr::select(
          minispin_run,
          processing_record_available
        ) |>
        dplyr::distinct(),
      by = "minispin_run"
    )

  processing_join_method <- "minispin_run"

} else if (
  processing_has_fiber &&
  nrow(processing_duplicate_fiber) == 0
) {

  sample_key_2022 <- sample_key_2022 |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      processing_ids |>
        dplyr::select(
          fiber_id,
          processing_record_available
        ) |>
        dplyr::distinct(),
      by = "fiber_id"
    )

  processing_join_method <- "fiber_id"

} else {

  sample_key_2022 <- sample_key_2022 |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      processing_record_available = NA
    )

  processing_join_method <-
    "No verified processing join"
}

processing_join_method
```

# 21. Finalize master-key flags

```{r finalize-master-key}
sample_key_2022 <- sample_key_2022 |>
  dplyr::mutate(

    afis_Bale = dplyr::coalesce(
      afis_Bale,
      0L
    ),

    afis_Opened = dplyr::coalesce(
      afis_Opened,
      0L
    ),

    afis_Carded = dplyr::coalesce(
      afis_Carded,
      0L
    ),

    afis_Sliver = dplyr::coalesce(
      afis_Sliver,
      0L
    ),

    afis_stage_count = dplyr::coalesce(
      afis_stage_count,
      0L
    ),

    afis_all_four_stages = dplyr::coalesce(
      afis_all_four_stages,
      FALSE
    ),

    afis_duplicate_stage = dplyr::coalesce(
      afis_duplicate_stage,
      FALSE
    ),

    processing_record_available =
      dplyr::coalesce(
        as.logical(
          processing_record_available
        ),
        FALSE
      ),

    core_identifiers_complete =
      !is.na(field_sample_id) &
      !is.na(genotype) &
      !is.na(micro_id) &
      !is.na(plot) &
      !is.na(fiber_id) &
      !is.na(minispin_run),

    sample_key_complete =
      core_identifiers_complete &
      afis_all_four_stages &
      processing_record_available
  ) |>

  dplyr::arrange(
    background,
    nil_set,
    genotype,
    field_rep_inferred,
    plot
  )

dplyr::glimpse(sample_key_2022)
```

# 24. Final audit summary

```{r final-audit-summary}
audit_summary <- tibble::tibble(

  check = c(
    "Master sample-key rows",
    "Unique field-sample IDs",
    "Unique Micro IDs",
    "Unique plots",
    "Unique Fiber IDs",
    "Unique MiniSpin runs",
    "Recognized genotype records",
    "Unrecognized genotype records",
    "AFIS raw rows",
    "AFIS completeness rows",
    "Samples with all four AFIS stages",
    "Samples with duplicate AFIS stages",
    "Samples with processing records",
    "Samples with complete core identifiers",
    "Samples passing complete-key check",
    "Duplicate field-sample IDs",
    "Duplicate Micro IDs",
    "Duplicate Fiber IDs",
    "Duplicate MiniSpin runs"
  ),

  observed = c(

    nrow(sample_key_2022),

    dplyr::n_distinct(
      sample_key_2022$field_sample_id,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    dplyr::n_distinct(
      sample_key_2022$micro_id,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    dplyr::n_distinct(
      sample_key_2022$plot,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    dplyr::n_distinct(
      sample_key_2022$fiber_id,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    dplyr::n_distinct(
      sample_key_2022$minispin_run,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    sum(
      !is.na(sample_key_2022$genotype)
    ),

    sum(
      is.na(sample_key_2022$genotype)
    ),

    nrow(afis_ids),

    nrow(afis_stage_summary),

    sum(
      sample_key_2022$afis_all_four_stages
    ),

    sum(
      sample_key_2022$afis_duplicate_stage
    ),

    sum(
      sample_key_2022$processing_record_available
    ),

    sum(
      sample_key_2022$core_identifiers_complete
    ),

    sum(
      sample_key_2022$sample_key_complete
    ),

    nrow(duplicate_field_sample_ids),
    nrow(duplicate_micro_ids),
    nrow(duplicate_fiber_ids),
    nrow(duplicate_minispin_runs)
  ),

  expected = c(
    92,
    92,
    92,
    92,
    92,
    92,
    92,
    0,
    368,
    92,
    92,
    0,
    92,
    92,
    92,
    0,
    0,
    0,
    0
  )
) |>

  dplyr::mutate(
    status = dplyr::if_else(
      observed == expected,
      "PASS",
      "REVIEW"
    )
  )
```
